summary: Full audit of the 3 bots (Bybit /bybit, HotForex /hotforex, Pepperstone /pepperstone). Backend: new suite tests/test_iter76_audit.py (20 tests, run serially -n 0). Sweep of all 82 GET routes without path params with Bearer: all 200 (klines x3 -> 422 without symbol); none slower than 15 s. 401 without token works; only /api/ is public (/api/meta requires auth, /api/health does not exist). Backtest SOLUSDT 1h (27 trades, PF 0.67) and EURUSD 1h on /api/fx (64 trades, PF 0.61) return numbers. /performance on all 3 bots includes 'daily'; /performance/pairs?days=30 is 200 on all 3; trade history is isolated (crypto 0, fx 2, pepper 0). LLM concurrency fix: 3 POST /ai/test calls fired at the same time (crypto, fx, pepper) all came back 200 ok:true, finishing at 3.1 s, 4.6 s and 6.1 s, which shows they ran one after another. The backend.err.log count of 'concurrent_request_limit' stayed at 52 (no new 429s). _serialized unit tests pass: two 429s then success returns the value after sleeps [2,5]; a non-429 error is re-raised at once with no sleep; four 429s in a row re-raise. Frontend (1920x1080): login, the selector with 3 cards, and Entrar on all 3 work. All 10 Bybit tabs and all 9 FX tabs (on both FX bots) render content with 0 console errors. 'Ajustes' (admin settings) opens on all 3 bots. The settings save round-trip (scan_interval_sec 60->70->60 on Bybit, 120->130->120 on HotForex) works and was restored; I deleted the 4 Evolución events it created. 'Cambiar bot' returns to the selector. The AI chat on HotForex gave a real Claude Sonnet answer in 8.7 s. Mobile (390x844) on /bybit and /hotforex: page scrollWidth is 390 (no horizontal overflow) and no element sticks out except the scrollable TabsList (overflow-x:auto, 1069/1049 px scroll width). The last tab (Régimen/Filtros) can be reached and activated.

Leftover test data: fx_account was recreated at 22:15:11 with net_deposits=200 and no cashflow items (/api/fx/account/cashflows items=[]), peak_equity 1020 (API shows 1220) and max_drawdown 70.59%. I did not change it (not on the restore list): reset the FX paper account or set net_deposits back to 0, after confirming with the user.

Leftover mock settings: bybit_base_url='http://localhost:8011', bybit_alert_after_sec=15, and dummy encrypted API key/secret (UI shows '••••' / '…cret'). Mode is still paper, so nothing breaks, but the Ajustes screen shows a localhost endpoint. Clear it (QUITAR) or restore the user's real values.

Not public (401 without token), even though the review request expected it to be. No /api/health exists. Only GET /api/ is public. This looks intentional; noted only because it differs from the request.
'asyncio - ERROR - Unclosed client session' on every hot reload (an aiohttp session is not closed in shutdown). Harmless noise.

issues: The sticky header (title, badges and 8 action buttons over 5 rows) takes about 345 px, roughly 40% of the 844 px viewport, and stays on screen while scrolling. Consider making it non-sticky on mobile or putting the actions in a menu.
The TabsList scrollbar is hidden ([scrollbar-width:none]), so nothing shows that more tabs exist off-screen. Consider an edge fade or arrow.

action_items: MEDIUM (code): ai_advisor._serialized retries call the same fn again. LlmChat.stream_message and send_message_with_tools both call _add_user_message(messages, …) BEFORE litellm.acompletion (checked in the emergentintegrations source). So after a 429 retry the history holds the user prompt twice (system,user,user), which doubles input tokens. In ask_tools(text=…) it also duplicates the user turn in the chat conversation. Fix: in run() / the ask_tools lambda, save n=len(await chat.get_messages()) before the call, and on retry trim back to n (del msgs[n:]) before calling again.
Clean the leftover HotForex paper account data (net_deposits=200 with no cashflows, peak 1220, DD 70.59%) after confirming with the user.
Clear the leftover Bybit mock endpoint http://localhost:8011, the 15 s alert and the dummy key/secret in the crypto config.
Find out which suite left the Bybit bot running (paper) at 22:23 and add a restore step to it (now stopped).
Optional: sticky header on mobile; a visual cue that the tab bar scrolls.
critical_code_review_comments: _serialized holds the global semaphore during the backoff sleeps (2+5+10 s). Up to 17 s of sleep, plus up to 4 attempts, block every other LLM call on all 3 bots. Acceptable with a 1-concurrency key, but a hung stream also blocks every LLM call because there is no timeout on fn(). Consider asyncio.wait_for around fn().
Retry on 429 re-sends the user message after it was already appended to history (see the action item above).
_gate = asyncio.Semaphore(1) at module level is fine on Python 3.11 (no loop binding at creation).

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 after correcting the /api/meta expectation; the only real deviation, the Bybit bot running, was restored)

seed_data_creation: None. Created and then deleted: 2 'changes' events and 2 'fx_changes' events from the scan_interval round-trip (deleted by exact ts). One chat message 'TEST_ En una frase: ¿está el bot de HotForex activo o detenido?' plus the AI reply stay in the shared chat_messages history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests/test_iter76_audit.py with -n 0 only. Writing files under /app/backend/tests triggers a uvicorn hot reload (the engine restarts with 'Motor iniciado'). A browser tool screenshot path built with an f-string gets mangled; use literal paths. Final state checked: Bybit paper and stopped, 11 symbols, ZEC/HYPE params 1.5/6/20, reopt [ZEC,HYPE]; FX and Pepper paper, stopped, price_action_block true. 429 count in backend.err.log is 52 (baseline).
rca of the issue: The state deviations (Bybit bot running, the FX account with a phantom $200 deposit, the localhost:8011 Bybit endpoint) all date from 22:13-22:23. That is when E1 ran the legacy suites (iter21 HFM mock, iter28 cashflows, iter49/iter5 Bybit mock, account reset). They are leftover test data, not app logic bugs.
